reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Mirror Trading International as a way to grow Bitcoin through a weekly binary profit share tied to a $200 trading-account balance and two direct referrals in opposing team positions. It offers a 10% commission for introducing people who invest, instructs participants to add Bitcoin to the weaker team leg, and directs questions to the sender. the available video evidence does not establish that payments occurred or returns were achieved.

citations.quote: There are two main advantages to becoming part of the MTI affiliate program.
you'll receive a 10% referral Commission on all amounts invested by people you personally introduce
To be Binary Qualified you will need a minimum of $200 in your trading account and have two direct referrals, one placed in the left team and the other in the right team.
There are two main advantages to becoming part of the MTI affiliate program. Number one, you'll receive a 10% referral Commission
you'll receive the weekly binary profit share

opening.argument: The presentation uses conditional rather than guaranteed language. It describes the weekly payment as dependent on positive trading results, and frames additional earnings as a possibility rather than an assured outcome. The affiliate program is explicitly optional, while the video also says many investors are not interested in it. That supports reading this as a qualified explanation of available participation terms, not a deceptive promise that every viewer will profit. The material also distinguishes the investment focus from the optional affiliate benefit, leaving viewers to decide whether recruitment is relevant to them.

citations.quote: Here is the possibility.
many investors are not interested in the Affiliate Program at all.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The quoted commission and referral conditions establish terms, but not deception or a guaranteed return. The reference itself concedes that payments or returns are not shown. The weekly share is expressly conditional on positive trading results, so presenting an eligibility structure is materially different from promising that the result is certain.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Conditional wording does not remove the central solicitation. The video still presents a weekly profit share, a 10% commission on investments by personally introduced people, and a requirement for two direct referrals. Calling the affiliate program optional does not change that recruitment-linked earnings are offered as a way to increase income.

citations.quote: you'll receive a 10% referral Commission on all amounts invested by people you personally introduce
To be Binary Qualified you will need a minimum of $200 in your trading account and have two direct referrals
with a little creativity the affiliate program can add to your earnings.

opening.argument: This is best understood as a welcome tutorial explaining how the MTI back office and binary qualification system work. It walks through an initial account state, identifies the left and right teams, explains the qualification conditions, and then demonstrates a hypothetical allocation of Bitcoin across those legs. The instruction is operational: viewers are shown how the system is structured and how adding to the weaker leg affects the described bonus calculation. Explaining a platform's process, including an optional affiliate feature, does not by itself establish that the presenter is making a false claim or soliciting deceptive investment.

citations.quote: Part 3 of the Welcome Videos - Maximising your Bitcoin Investment
When you look at your MTI back office you will see that there is a left team and a right team.
Upon starting, you will usually have zero team members on the left and right
Now let's assume you invested 0.1 Bitcoin on the left and 0.15 Bitcoin on the right.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the video a tutorial does not answer what the tutorial teaches. Its operational walkthrough specifically explains how to qualify for and increase a profit share through direct referrals, team placement, and additional investment. The final instruction to contact the sender also gives the presentation a participation pathway, rather than making it merely neutral commentary.

citations.quote: To be Binary Qualified you will need a minimum of $200 in your trading account and have two direct referrals
You can increase this weekly bonus by adding more investment into the weakest team of your business

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The instructional format is precisely how the recruitment mechanism is communicated. The walkthrough does not merely describe software navigation: it explains a 10% commission for personally introduced investors and says two direct referrals are needed for binary qualification. A hypothetical example can still promote participation when it shows how to place family members and increase earnings.

citations.quote: What if you open two positions for family members?
you'll receive a 10% referral Commission on all amounts invested by people you personally introduce

opening.argument: The affiliate component is presented as an optional referral promotion attached to a Bitcoin investment service, comparable in form to an ordinary incentive program. The record does not show a credential request, a claimed guaranteed return, evidence of actual payouts, or an outcome for any participant. It also does not establish that merely viewing the video requires a deposit or that anyone is compelled to recruit. What is shown is a stated commission opportunity, conditional qualification rules, and an instruction that viewers may add Bitcoin if they choose.

citations.quote: The focus of MirroTrading International is to grow your Bitcoin and the focus of MTI is on the investor.
You can add more to your investment, or more team members and you'll benefit even further.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The absence of a credential request or displayed payout does not make the promotion ordinary commerce. The stated mechanism itself links earnings to personally introduced investors, opposing team positions, and adding investment to the weaker leg. Those are affirmative recruitment and funding instructions, not merely a generic referral discount.

citations.quote: you'll receive a 10% referral Commission on all amounts invested by people you personally introduce
have two direct referrals, one placed in the left team and the other in the right team.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing evidence of completed payouts is not exculpatory because the classification concerns the promoted mechanism. This is not a simple discount: the program offers a weekly binary profit share, requires a minimum personal account balance and two direct referrals, and encourages adding investment to the weaker team leg. The optional label changes participation status, not the nature of the incentive.
